name: ROS 2 (Robot Operating System 2)
problems: steep learning curve due to large number of interdependent packages and concepts (nodes, topics, services, actions, DDS middleware)
distribution-specific compatibility (Rolling, Jazzy, Humble, etc.) can complicate dependency management
source_notes: Meta-repository for the Robot Operating System (ROS) 2, a meta operating system and middleware framework for robot software, maintained by Open Robotics / OSRF.
